assessment.match_notes: Task requires ammonium carbonate in the solution state. The real ammonium carbonate photographs on Commons (Ammonium Carbonate.jpg CC BY-SA 2.0 from Flickr; Ammonium carbonate.JPG PD by Chemicalinterest; Uhlicitan amonny.JPG) all show the solid chunky material. None shows an aqueous ammonium carbonate solution, so the solution-state requirement cannot be met. Additionally, ordinary commercial 'ammonium carbonate' solid is a mixture of ammonium bicarbonate and ammonium carbamate rather than pure (NH4)2CO3, which would weaken even a solid-state claim. Since using the solid photos would misrepresent the required solution state, the honest result is NO_EXACT_REAL_PHOTO.
